summary: Blocks CSS rules that combine a ch or em reading measure with a background.
doc: This hook denies a write when one CSS rule block declares both a background fill and a width or max-width in ch or em units. The fill defines the block edge, while the reading measure leaves space before that edge. Narrow the block to the measure, or keep the block wide and remove the measure. Moving the same cap to an inner span does not fix the rule. The hook checks only the same-element case. A bare ch cap inside a separately filled ancestor requires a rendered-page check.
